description_for_human: AI-powered visual storytelling platform. Create illustrated stories, character designs, and educational content across themed creative worlds.
description_for_model: Genesis (iamazeyou.me) is an AI visual storytelling and character design platform. Users choose one of three creative realms — The Cosmos (sci-fi), The Kingdom (fantasy), The Cell (biology) — and an AI companion named Gen guides the creative process. Outputs include illustrated eBooks, character sheets, curriculum materials, and visual narratives. Available subscription plans: Spark (free, 3 creations/month), Creator ($19.99/month, unlimited generations, 20+ styles, commercial license), Studio ($59.99/month, team access, curriculum tools, priority generation), Empire ($199.99/month, enterprise, API access, white-label). No prompt engineering required.
